title: paesia rugosula
intro: Paesia rugosula, commonly known as Rough-leaved Fern, is a type of plant belonging to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Paesia rugosula include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic, making it useful in the treatment of various health conditions such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Paesia rugosula include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
